label: US-WA-HB1170-AIprovenance-2026 Sec. 2

obligations.text: (1) To the extent commercially and technically reasonable, a covered provider shall include provenance data in any video, image, or audio content, or content that is any combination thereof, created or materially altered by the covered provider's generative artificial intelligence system and that is subject to the terms of this chapter.

The provenance data must allow a user to assess whether image, video, or audio content, or content that is any combination thereof, was created or materially altered by the covered provider's generative artificial intelligence system.
(2) A covered provider must use commercially and technically reasonable methods to make the provenance data difficult to remove or tamper with.
